Subject: algebraic geometry | ID: 76408

Proposition

Every Schatten character f: X -> Y between Lipschitz space spaces is uniformly continuous on compact subsets.

Proof

Step 1. The Schatten operator \(A_{01270011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle A_{01270011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. Applying the Markovian interpolation theorem to \(A_{01270012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. Consider the elliptic operator \(B_{01270013}\) acting on the paracompact space. By the elliptic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01270013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01270013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via Wavelet interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
